description: Implementation of the FutexWaiter class for synchronization, including wait, post, and poke methods, with platform-specific timeout handling.

classes.name: FutexWaiter
classes.description: A class providing futex-based waiting and notification mechanisms for thread synchronization.

methods.name: WaitUntil
methods.description: Waits on an atomic integer until a condition is met or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits on the futex until it is signaled or timeout occurs, with internal loop handling.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Increments the futex value and potentially wakes a waiting thread.

methods.name: Poke
methods.description: Wakes one thread waiting on the futex.
